about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). Quick steps run on The Dragon; a wide change also runs the full suite on The Beast. The Docker image build stays with the Docker workflow.

steps.name: rust
steps.about: Clippy of the crate, then the tests of the changed modules (src/quota/x.rs runs the tests named quota::x::…).
steps.run: set --; for f in {files}; do m=${f#src/}; m=${m%.rs}; m=${m%/mod}; set -- "$@" "$(printf %s "$m" | sed 's#/#::#g')::"; done; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -- "$@"

full: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && N=/cache/npm/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64 && { [ -x $N/bin/node ] || curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /cache/npm; } && $N/bin/node --test tests/*.test.cjs
